credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/moonflower.py. Reference photo moonflower/adult.jpg by Epibase (CC BY 3.0), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ipomoea.alba.jpg: used as a drawing reference, not traced. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: WHITE: the trumpet is really white (a white part); lit like a cup, the white is the limb and the funnel, with sage and violet inside. Crystal rule. REARING. Gesture: the trumpet unfurls (a furled spindle twists open into a cupped trumpet, flares wide, held, and settles). The petals are the real white, so the white cap is kept by lighting the trumpet like a cup: the lit limb white, the inside wall and the star sage, the throat violet and black. Sport: the lilac moonflower Ipomoea muricata (the star and the cup turn lilac).
